 Q2 Results, Nov 12: HAL, Vodafone Idea, Hitachi Energy, RVNL, IRCTC, Alkem Labs, Oil India, Page Industries, Bharat Dynamics, others to post earnings
 By Kamal Joshi 7 min read | Updated on November 12, 2026, 07:46 IST
 Preferred news source Select Upstox as your Preferred news source SUMMARY
 Innerwear manufacturer Page Industries, ammunitions and missile systems maker Bharat Dynamics, railways ticketing and booking platform Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corp, gold loan NBFC Manappuram Finance, and electric two-wheeler maker Ola Electric Mobility, among others, will also post earnings on November 12. 
 Stock list
 HAL -- IDEA -- POWERINDIA -- RVNL -- IRCTC -- More than 400 companies will post earnings for Q2 FY27 on Thursday, November 12. | Image: Shutterstock
 The Q2 earnings season is in its last leg and several companies will announce their financial data for the current fiscal year on Thursday, November 12. The list includes defence and aerospace company Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd , telecom services provider Vodafone Idea, power grid and electrification technology firm Hitachi Energy India, crude oil explorer Oil India , pharma player Alkem Laboratories, iron ore producer NMDC and Indian Railways construction arm Rail Vikas Nigam.

 Innerwear manufacturer Page Industries, ammunition and missile systems maker Bharat Dynamics, railway ticketing and booking platform Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corp, gold loan NBFC Manappuram Finance , FMCG company Procter and Gamble Hygiene and Health Care, air conditioner manufacturer Amber Enterprises India, AC generator and motors maker TD Power Systems, Oberoi Group's flagship company EIH, pharmaceuticals firm Caplin Point Laboratories and electric two-wheeler maker Ola Electric Mobility, among others, will also post earnings on November 12. 
 Additionally, high-end radio frequency (RF) and microwave module manufacturer Astra Microwave Products, airport dining and lounge operator Travel Food Services, power transmission component manufacturer Bonfiglioli Transmissions, speciality fats and butter maker Manorama Industries, integrated steel maker NMDC Steel, and power general company Reliance Power will also declare their latest Q2 report cards on November 12.

 On Wednesday, Tata Power recorded a 49% increase in its consolidated profit after tax to ₹1,366 crore in Q2 FY27, compared to ₹919 crore in the same period last year. 
 The company's revenue from operations climbed 26% to ₹19,636 crore in the latest September quarter versus ₹15,545 crore in the year-ago period.
